q: Location: Al Thumama & Bani Hajer, Doha, Qatar

London Education Centre (LEC) provides academic support and tutoring services across its branches. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Finance Officer to manage financial operations, maintain accurate records, and support the organisation's financial planning and reporting.

The Finance Officer will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, student fee collections, financial reporting, payroll coordination, budgeting, and compliance. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting knowledge, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial records accurately.
Monitor student fee collections and outstanding payments.
Manage invoicing, accounts receivable, and payment follow-ups.
Maintain accurate records of student payments and financial transactions.
Coordinate with the admissions and operations teams regarding fee-related matters.
Maintain accurate financial records and accounting entries.
Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow reports.
Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
Perform bank and payment gateway reconciliations.
Support monthly and annual financial closing activities.
Assist in preparing annual budgets and financial forecasts.
Monitor expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
Prepare cash flow forecasts and financial performance reports.
Support management with financial analysis and decision-making.
Ensure payroll accuracy and timely salary payments.
Handle supplier payments and expense documentation.
Support compliance with Qatar's Wage Protection System (WPS).
Maintain proper financial documentation and records.
Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and internal policies.
Implement and maintain effective financial controls.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
4–6 years of relevant finance or accounting experience.
ACCA, CPA, CMA, or CIMA qualification will be an advantage.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
Experience in payroll processing, bank reconciliation, budgeting, and cash flow management.
Familiarity with Qatar's financial regulations and WPS requirements is preferred.
Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and problem-solving abilities.
Working knowledge of accounting software such as Zoho Books or QuickBooks.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
Experience with financial dashboards and reporting tools such as Looker Studio will be an advantage.
Performance will be evaluated based on
Accuracy and timely completion of payroll.
Timely monthly financial reporting and closing.
Accuracy of financial records and reporting dashboards.

d: We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Operations Manager to lead, optimize, and oversee end-to-end express delivery and hub operations. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring seamless first-mile, sorting, transportation, and last-mile operations while driving service efficiency, maintaining safety compliance, and meeting operational KPIs.
q: Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in express delivery, last-mile logistics, e-commerce operations, or supply chain management.
Leadership: Proven track record in managing large operational teams and multi-site hub operations.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in logistics management systems (WMS/TMS), MS Excel, and operational data analytics.
Key Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, high stress tolerance in a fast-paced environment, and clear stakeholder communication.
Language Requirements: Fluency in English (Hindi/Urdu or Arabic fluency is often preferred depending on the regional market).
r: Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including pickup, sorting, transportation, and last-mile parcel delivery.
Monitor daily branch/hub activities to ensure operational targets and service level agreements (SLAs) are met consistently.
Plan and optimize delivery routes and driver dispatch schedules to reduce transit times and operational costs.
Track and report on key operational metrics, such as On-Time Delivery (OTD), delivery success rate, and cost-per-parcel.
Drive process improvement initiatives to reduce parcel damage, missing rates, and customer complaints.
Conduct regular reviews of operational efficiency and present reports to senior management.
Lead, mentor, and manage supervisors, sorting staff, couriers, and fleet personnel.
Oversee manpower planning, shift schedules, peak-season resource allocation, and recruitment needs.
Foster a safe, high-performance, and accountable work environment.
Ensure full compliance with company SOPs, safety policies, and local labor/transportation regulations.
Enforce strict protocols around proof of delivery (POD), parcel handling, and inventory control.
